creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Seen 2026-11-06 on Muster 0.23.0: `muster harness install codex --dry-run` printed nothing for over 60 seconds with a hanging Homebrew Codex 0.167 first on PATH. Pointing PATH at a working Codex made it print its plan and exit 0. The claude-code dry run printed its plan at once.

A dry run should not need the harness to answer. Failing that, bound the call and say which harness command it is waiting on. crates/muster-cli/src/harness.rs.
title: `muster harness install --dry-run` runs the harness, so a hung harness hangs it
